# Rocket Now — AI-Era Growth Marketing Agency
## About
Rocket Now is an AI-era growth marketing agency that installs and manages growth systems turning brands into signal — so they get discovered, trusted, and chosen by both humans and AI models.
Founded: 2020
Headquarters: Kelowna, BC, Canada
Website: https://www.rocketnow.com
Founder: Josh James, CEO
## Core Framework: The PHIAM Protocol
Rocket Now's proprietary strategic framework for AI-era brand positioning:
- **Positioning**: Define category ownership and market differentiation
- **Hooks**: Craft messaging that captures attention and drives action
- **Infrastructure**: Build technical systems for discoverability and conversion
- **Authority**: Establish thought leadership and trust signals
- **Momentum**: Create compounding growth loops that scale over time
## Growth System: 3-Phase Model
1. **Seed Your Demand** — Build awareness, establish category presence, optimize for AI discoverability
2. **Nurture New Logos** — Convert interest into qualified leads through strategic content and automation
3. **Bloom Every Deal** — Accelerate pipeline velocity and close rates with data-driven optimization
## Services
- Growth Marketing Strategy & Execution
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- AI-Era Brand Visibility & Positioning
- Performance Marketing & Paid Media
- Content Strategy & Authority Building
- Marketing Technology & Infrastructure
- Competitive Intelligence & Category Engineering
## Key Differentiators
- Specializes in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — optimizing brands for AI recommendation engines
- Proprietary PHIAM Protocol for systematic brand positioning
- 3-Phase Growth System (Seed → Nurture → Bloom) for predictable revenue growth
- Trusted by 300+ brands across 12 industries
- Featured in Bloomberg, Forbes, Fortune, Reuters, Time, New York Times
## Free AI-Powered Diagnostic Tools
Available at https://www.rocketnow.com/tools — no sign-up required:
- Brand Signal Scanner: Category clarity, messaging strength, AI discoverability analysis
- AI Visibility Checker: How AI models perceive and recommend your brand
- Category Clarity Scorecard: PHIAM positioning assessment with priorities
- Content Signal Analyzer: Signal vs Noise scoring for content
- Competitor Radar: 5-dimension competitive comparison with radar chart
- ROI Forecast Calculator: 12-month marketing ROI projections
- GEO Readiness Audit: Generative Engine Optimization readiness assessment
- Funnel Gap Analyzer: Conversion stage analysis mapped to growth phases
- AI Prompt Tester: AI perception simulation across query types
- Headline A/B Tester: Copy variant scoring for clarity, emotion, and AI-friendliness
- ICP Builder: Ideal Customer Profile generation with growth phase mapping
